name: Pop Sums
summary: A fun-fair maths game: pop numbered balloons that add up to the target exactly, without going over
about: A sports day fair stall in bold sticker style, with a turning sunburst, a big wheel, striped tents, bunting and a dart stand that throws at every balloon you pick. The target sits on a flipping ticket, your sum fills a striped meter and each popped number flies over to join the written sum. Eight levels add bigger targets, red minus balloons, golden doubles and faster wind; three busts or the closing bell end the game.
how: A demo round plays on load; press Play, My turn, a number key or tap the field to take over.
Click or tap a balloon to pop it, or type its digit to pop the highest balloon with that number.
Reach the target exactly: going over is a bust and tears one of your three tickets; 0 or Empty the jar starts the sum again.
From level 3, press minus then a digit for red take-away balloons; from level 4, X pops a golden double.
Quick sums and runs of exact sums raise the score; leftover time is a bonus. P pauses and R restarts.
Your best score is saved on this device, and reduced motion stops the sunburst and shaking.
